translations.web: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
translations.bsb: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
translations.kjv: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
translations.asv: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old, and begat Arpachshad two years after the flood.
